voskNote: Vosk (live) on the passage: 45.3% with this scorer (S71 D4 I31, N=234), reproduced from the bundle's `transcript/r1.json`. an earlier measurement gave 40.7%; the plain normaliser (lowercase + punctuation only) reproduces that exactly (40.7%, N=273). The number rule folds 39 reference words into number tokens (N=234), so the same transcript scores 45.3%. OpenAI whisper-1: **not run (no key)**.
narrationMethod:
No human reference exists. Reference = faster-whisper `large-v3` (Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3@edaa852e, CPU int8, beam 5, language en, condition_on_previous_text=False, no VAD). A ticket correction to one sentence of the narration was checked: large-v3 already wrote exactly that, so no correction was applied. Vosk's "okay sir" is "Okay, so" and "kadosh" is "and could not" in large-v3 (medium.en: "in Kodawat").

Sensitivity check: every row is also scored against faster-whisper `medium.en` (Systran/faster-whisper-medium.en@a29b04bd, same settings).

Validation of the method on the passage (true reference known): faster-whisper large-v3 scored 6.0% and medium.en 9.8% against Matt's text.

Narration rows were run at 8 threads (base, small, turbo enc-fp16/dec-q4) before the thread-count request, and at 4 threads for the later rows; faster-whisper narration runs used the ctranslate2 default thread count and have no RSS reading.

sections.title: Parakeet in transformers.js 4.3.1
lines: - **CTC: yes.** `ParakeetForCTC` (model_type `parakeet_ctc`, `AutoModelForCTC`); the ASR pipeline sends it through `_call_wav2vec2` — text only, no timestamps. Repo: `onnx-community/parakeet-ctc-0.6b-ONNX@7df2cab7aed886b8b7f80d68a8214007e4847601`, dtype q8 = `model_quantized.onnx` (+ `.onnx_data`).

- **Pipeline bug:** `_call_wav2vec2` argmaxes every frame and calls `tokenizer.decode(ids)`. Parakeet's tokenizer.json has a Metaspace decoder, not a CTC decoder, so repeated frames are never collapsed (blank = `<pad>` id 1024 is dropped as a special token). Result: "nararwal", "payroroll", "skyy". Pipeline row WER 16.2%; the same logits with a correct greedy CTC collapse (own code, `js/ctc.mjs`) score -.

- **TDT: no.** No transducer/TDT class in 4.3.1. `onnx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-ONNX` exists (fp32 only, 2.5 GB, no model_type) for other runtimes. Parakeet TDT was measured with sherpa-onnx (`sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8`, k2-fsa release `asr-models`), which returns per-token start times (`result.timestamps`); word starts = the token that begins with "▁".

sections.title: Scorer and reproduction
lines: `node score.mjs <reference.txt> <hyp.txt>... [--align] [--json]` — WER = (S+D+I)/N over normalised words from a minimum-edit alignment. Normalisation, identical on both sides: lowercase; curly apostrophes -> '; commas inside digit groups removed and "." kept only between digits; "$" dropped; every other char not in [a-z0-9'] -> space; spelled numbers -> digits (hyphens split first; "and" inside a number is absorbed; groups that cannot combine are joined as digit strings: "twenty twenty six" -> 2026, "one twenty five" -> 125); "<N> dollars and <M> cents" and "<N> and <M> cents" -> N.MM; "dollars" after a number dropped. So "one hundred and twenty-three thousand, four hundred and fifty-six dollars and seventy-eight cents" = "$123,456.78" = token `123456.78`. Nothing else is expanded (W-2 -> "w 2" but W2 -> "w2"; "3rd" ≠ "third").

Any recording (webm/m4a/wav): `to16k.sh <in> <out.wav>`; transformers.js: `js/go.sh <set> <audio> <label> <threads> <repo> <revision> <dtypeJSON> <word|none>` (env WARM_LOAD=0, SEGMENT_MAX=20 for Moonshine, MAX_NEW_TOKENS=1024 for Cohere); Parakeet CTC own decode: `js/ctc.sh <set> <audio> <threads>`; Parakeet TDT: `sherpa.sh <set> <audio> <threads>`; faster-whisper: `fw.sh <set> <audio> <model> <threads>`; then `node build.mjs && node make-extras.mjs && node render.mjs`. Batches used: `batch-passage.sh 4`, `batch-3.sh`, `batch-4.sh`. Each model run was wrapped in `suite-gate` and returned `VERDICT=RAN exit=0` (logs in `out/*.log`).
